title: Intuitiveness Session Export Record
description: Versioned, self-contained, full-fidelity export of a redesign session's branching tree. Designed to be loadable WITHOUT importing the intuitiveness package: a consumer only needs the documented decode rules below. Realizes spec FR-023..FR-028.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of THIS record format. Consumers MUST fail-closed on an unknown future major version rather than guess.

root_id.description: id of the L4 entry node

current_id.description: id of the active node at export time

nodes.description: FLAT map keyed by node id. Branches sharing ancestors reference the SAME id; each node is stored exactly once (FR-026). Reconstruct the tree by following parent_id/children_ids.

parent_id.description: null only for the root (L4 entry).

edge_decision.description: The typed params/choice that produced this node from its parent (e.g. {"domains":[...]}, {"column":"x","filter_query":null}, {"aggregation":"sum"}, {"dimensions":[...]}). Empty {} for the root.

lineage.description: Ordered list of provenance steps from raw origin to THIS node. Denormalized (FR-001).

payload_kind.description: Determines how to decode `payload`. See decode rules.

payload.description: Encoded data payload. Decode per payload_kind (see x-decode-rules).

parameters.description: Direction-specific detail rides here: enrichment_function, dimensions_added, column, filter_query, aggregation, domains, etc.

x-decode-rules.description: How to materialize `payload` per `payload_kind` WITHOUT the intuitiveness package.
x-decode-rules.unlinkable: payload is an object mapping source name -> dataframe-encoded string (decode each as 'dataframe' below). Represents an L4 collection of raw sources.
x-decode-rules.graph: payload is a JSON string of a networkx node-link object (json.loads -> {nodes:[...], links:[...]}). Any node-link-compatible graph reader can consume it.
x-decode-rules.dataframe: payload is base64( zlib.compress( utf-8 CSV bytes ) ). Decode: base64-decode -> zlib-decompress -> read CSV. (Exact codec matches persistence/serializers.serialize_dataframe.)
x-decode-rules.vector: payload is base64( zlib.compress( utf-8 CSV bytes of a single-column series ) ); decode as dataframe then take the single column. Carries the series name in edge_decision/lineage parameters.
x-decode-rules.value: payload is a JSON scalar (string/number/boolean/null) — the atomic L0 datum.

x-invariants.single-occurrence: Each node id appears once in `nodes` (FR-026/SC-009): shared ancestors are not duplicated per branch.
x-invariants.tree-reconstruction: On load, re-link parent_id/children_ids so branches sharing an ancestor point to the SAME node object (FR-028).
x-invariants.version-fail-closed: Unknown future schema_version major => reject, do not partially parse (Assumptions: schema versioning policy).
